### GT table: Longest active FBS streaks

```{r active-streaks-table, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# The longest active win and losing streaks in FBS, drawn as Scrabble racks:
# Indiana's wins on top, Charlotte's losses below. One tile per game, in order,
# with each team's next opponent as a dashed tile. Every game counts, FCS
# opponents included, and those tiles get their own muted colors.
#
# Reads local snapshots of collegefootballdata.com games through October 11,
# 2026, so the post rebuilds without hitting the API:
#   active_streak_games.csv       every game in both streaks
#   active_streak_next_games.csv  each team's next game
#   fbs_streaks_since_2014.csv    every FBS win or losing streak of 10+ games
#                                 since 2014, for the rankings and leaderboards

team_colors <- c(Indiana = "#990000", Charlotte = "#005035")

# Tile fill and border by result, with muted versions for FCS opponents.
win_fill <- "#D4EDD0"
win_edge <- "#8CBF84"
loss_fill <- "#F8D7DD"
loss_edge <- "#D99AA6"
fcs_win_fill <- "#E3E8DC"
fcs_win_edge <- "#A9B5A0"
fcs_loss_fill <- "#EBAFBB"
fcs_loss_edge <- "#C77789"
blank_edge <- "#C9A465"

# Neutral charcoal for the table frame and the racks under each row of tiles.
frame_color <- "#4A4A4A"

streak_games <- readr::read_csv("active_streak_games.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
next_games <- readr::read_csv("active_streak_next_games.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
streaks <- readr::read_csv("fbs_streaks_since_2014.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(games)), .by = result) |>
  dplyr::arrange(result, rank, dplyr::desc(active), first_season)

# cfbplotR's gt logo helper is broken against the installed gt, so use its
# logo lookup directly.
team_logo_url <- function(team) {
  lookup_name <- dplyr::recode(
    team,
    "App State" = "Appalachian State",
    "Massachusetts" = "UMass",
    .default = team
  )
  unname(cfbplotR:::logo_list[cfbplotR::clean_school_names(lookup_name, keep_non_matches = TRUE)])
}

ordinal <- function(x) {
  suffix <- if (x %% 100 %in% 11:13) "th" else c("th", "st", "nd", "rd", rep("th", 6))[x %% 10 + 1]
  paste0(x, suffix)
}

season_span <- function(first, last) {
  paste0(first, dplyr::if_else(first == last, "", paste0("–", last %% 100)))
}

tile_html <- function(logo, score, corner, site, opponent, fill, edge) {
  paste0(
    "<div title='", opponent, "' style='position:relative;width:92px;height:96px;margin:0 auto;",
    "background:", fill, ";border:1px solid ", edge, ";border-radius:7px;",
    "box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12),0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);'>",
    "<span style='position:absolute;top:4px;left:7px;font-size:10px;color:#7a6440;font-weight:600;'>",
    site, "</span>",
    "<img src='", logo, "' style='height:46px;width:46px;object-fit:contain;margin-top:13px;'>",
    "<div style='font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2b2112;margin-top:3px;",
    "font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;'>", score, "</div>",
    "<span style='position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:9.5px;",
    "font-weight:700;color:#7a6440;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;'>",
    corner, "</span>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

blank_tile_html <- function(logo, label) {
  paste0(
    "<div style='position:relative;width:92px;height:96px;margin:0 auto;",
    "background:transparent;border:2px dashed ", blank_edge, ";border-radius:7px;box-sizing:border-box;'>",
    "<img src='", logo, "' style='height:46px;width:46px;object-fit:contain;margin-top:13px;",
    "opacity:0.35;filter:grayscale(100%);'>",
    "<div style='font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#7a6440;margin-top:3px;'>", label, "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

# One rack section per team: five tiles to a row, one row group per season.
build_team_rack <- function(streak, upcoming) {
  singular <- if (streak$win[1]) "win" else "loss"
  plural <- if (streak$win[1]) "wins" else "losses"
  per_season <- dplyr::count(streak, season)
  label_for <- \(team, season) {
    n <- per_season$n[match(season, per_season$season)]
    paste0(team, " · ", season, " · ", n, " ", dplyr::if_else(n == 1, singular, plural))
  }

  if (streak$win[1]) {
    fill <- dplyr::if_else(streak$fcs, fcs_win_fill, win_fill)
    edge <- dplyr::if_else(streak$fcs, fcs_win_edge, win_edge)
  } else {
    fill <- dplyr::if_else(streak$fcs, fcs_loss_fill, loss_fill)
    edge <- dplyr::if_else(streak$fcs, fcs_loss_edge, loss_edge)
  }

  tiles <- streak |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      season = label_for(team, season),
      site = dplyr::if_else(site == "@", "at", site),
      site = dplyr::if_else(fcs, paste0(site, " · FCS"), site),
      # Winner's points first either way, the way a score is usually quoted.
      score = paste0(dplyr::if_else(win, "W ", "L "), pmax(pf, pa), "–", pmin(pf, pa)),
      # Bottom edge of the tile: date played, then place in the streak.
      corner = paste0(
        as.integer(format(game_date, "%m")), "/", as.integer(format(game_date, "%d")),
        "/", format(game_date, "%Y"), " | ", game_no
      ),
      html = tile_html(team_logo_url(opponent), score, corner, site, opponent, fill, edge)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(season, html)

  if (nrow(upcoming) == 1) {
    label <- paste0(
      if (upcoming$site == "@") "at " else "vs ",
      format(upcoming$game_date, "%b "), as.integer(format(upcoming$game_date, "%d"))
    )
    # A next game in a season the streak hasn't reached yet gets its own group.
    group <- if (upcoming$season %in% per_season$season) {
      label_for(streak$team[1], upcoming$season)
    } else {
      paste0(streak$team[1], " · ", upcoming$season)
    }
    tiles <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      tiles,
      tibble::tibble(season = group, html = blank_tile_html(team_logo_url(upcoming$opponent), label))
    )
  }

  tiles |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      slot = (dplyr::row_number() - 1) %% 5 + 1,
      rack = (dplyr::row_number() - 1) %/% 5 + 1,
      .by = season
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = slot, values_from = html, names_prefix = "t") |>
    dplyr::select(-rack)
}

# Header block for one team: logo, the streak, and how it ranks since 2014.
streak_card_html <- function(streak) {
  team <- streak$team[1]
  result <- if (streak$win[1]) "win" else "loss"
  ranked <- dplyr::filter(streaks, .data$result == .env$result)

  this_rank <- ranked |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$team == .env$team, active) |>
    dplyr::pull(rank)
  record <- dplyr::filter(ranked, rank == 1)
  record_text <- paste0(
    record$team, " (", season_span(record$first_season, record$last_season), ")",
    collapse = "<br>"
  )
  tied <- sum(ranked$rank == this_rank) > 1
  rank_text <- if (this_rank == 1) {
    "Longest since 2014"
  } else {
    paste0(
      if (tied) "Tied for " else "", ordinal(this_rank), "-longest since 2014",
      "<br>Record: ", record$games[1], "<br>", record_text
    )
  }

  paste0(
    "<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:1;'>",
    "<img src='", team_logo_url(team), "' style='height:64px;width:64px;object-fit:contain;'>",
    "<div style='line-height:1.15;'>",
    "<div style='font-size:34px;font-weight:800;color:", team_colors[[team]], ";'>", nrow(streak), "</div>",
    "<div style='font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#1a1a1a;'>straight ",
    if (streak$win[1]) "wins" else "losses", "</div>",
    "<div style='font-size:11px;color:#6a6a6a;margin-top:2px;'>", rank_text, "</div>",
    "</div></div>"
  )
}

leaders_text <- function(result, top = 5) {
  streaks |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$result == .env$result, rank <= top) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      line = paste0(
        team, " ", games, " (", season_span(first_season, last_season),
        dplyr::if_else(active, ", active", ""), ")"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(line) |>
    paste(collapse = " · ")
}

win_streak <- dplyr::filter(streak_games, team == "Indiana")
loss_streak <- dplyr::filter(streak_games, team == "Charlotte")

rack <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  build_team_rack(win_streak, dplyr::filter(next_games, team == "Indiana")),
  build_team_rack(loss_streak, dplyr::filter(next_games, team == "Charlotte"))
)
tile_cols <- grep("^t[0-9]+$", names(rack), value = TRUE)

group_labels <- unique(rack$season)
team_of_group <- stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_extract(group_labels, "^[^·]+"))
first_loss_group <- group_labels[team_of_group == "Charlotte"][1]

streaks_gt <- rack |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(tile_cols), \(x) dplyr::coalesce(x, ""))) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "season") |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_broadsheet(accent = frame_color) |>
  gt::fmt_passthrough(columns = dplyr::all_of(tile_cols), escape = FALSE) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = dplyr::everything()) |>
  gt::cols_width(dplyr::everything() ~ gt::px(108)) |>
  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = frame_color, weight = gt::px(7)),
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "transparent", weight = gt::px(0))
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body()
  ) |>
  # Extra air above Charlotte's racks so the two sections read apart.
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "#1a1a1a", weight = gt::px(2)),
      "padding-top: 22px;"
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(groups = first_loss_group)
  )

for (tm in names(team_colors)) {
  streaks_gt <- streaks_gt |>
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_colors[[tm]], size = gt::px(13)),
      locations = gt::cells_row_groups(groups = group_labels[team_of_group == tm])
    )
}

streaks_gt <- streaks_gt |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::html("<div style='text-align:center;'><b>Longest Active FBS Streaks</b></div>"),
    subtitle = gt::html(paste0(
      "<div style='display:flex;gap:24px;margin-top:10px;font-style:normal;'>",
      streak_card_html(win_streak),
      streak_card_html(loss_streak),
      "</div>"
    ))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(paste0(
    "<hr>Each tile is one game, in order: green for a win and pink for a loss, ",
    "with muted green for a win over an FCS team and dark pink for a loss to one. ",
    "Scores list the winner first, and the bottom of each tile shows the date ",
    "the game was played and its place in the streak. ",
    "In the top corner, vs marks a home game, at an away game and N a neutral site.<hr>",
    "<b>Longest win streaks since 2014:</b> ", leaders_text("win"), "<br><hr>",
    "<b>Longest losing streaks since 2014:</b> ", leaders_text("loss"),
    "<hr>Table by Chris at Bless your Chart | Data from collegefootballdata.com | cfbtxt.com"
  ))) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::px(600),
    table.font.size = gt::px(13),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(8),
    heading.align = "left"
  )

# Pad the PNG in the theme's own background rather than white.
streaks_options <- streaks_gt[["_options"]]
gtUtils::gt_save_crop(
  streaks_gt,
  file = "active_streaks.png",
  bg = streaks_options$value[[which(streaks_options$parameter == "table_background_color")]],
  zoom = 2,
  whitespace = 40
)

streaks_gt
```

### GT table: States with the most FBS teams

```{r fbs-states-table, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Which states have the most FBS teams? The top five, each row carrying an
# outline of the state with a dot for every team's stadium, plus the logos.
#
# Reads local snapshots so the post rebuilds without hitting the API:
#   fbs_schools_2026.csv     the 138 FBS teams in 2026, with each home
#                            stadium's state and coordinates (collegefootballdata.com)
#   us_state_outlines.csv    state outlines, one row per polygon vertex, from the
#                            PublicaMundi US states GeoJSON

accent_color <- "#1F5FA6"
outline_fill <- "#F2F2F2"
outline_color <- "#1a1a1a"
top_n <- 5

schools <- readr::read_csv("fbs_schools_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
outlines <- readr::read_csv("us_state_outlines.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

counts <- schools |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_schools = dplyr::n(), schools = list(sort(school)), .by = state) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state_name = state.name[match(state, state.abb)],
    rank = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(n_schools))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(rank, state_name)

plot_state_outline <- function(state_abb) {
  shape <- dplyr::filter(outlines, state_name == state.name[match(state_abb, state.abb)])
  points <- dplyr::filter(schools, state == state_abb)

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = shape,
      ggplot2::aes(x = lon, y = lat, group = ring),
      fill = outline_fill,
      color = outline_color,
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = points,
      ggplot2::aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),
      color = "white",
      fill = accent_color,
      shape = 21,
      size = 9,
      stroke = 1.4
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_quickmap() +
    ggplot2::theme_void()
}

# Each team is a fixed-width tile, logo over name, so the grid lines up and
# long names ("Florida International") wrap inside their own tile.
logo_strip_html <- function(teams) {
  tiles <- paste0(
    '<div style="width:62px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;">',
    '<img src="', sub("^http:", "https:", team_logo_url(teams)),
    '" style="height:26px;width:26px;object-fit:contain;">',
    '<span style="font-size:9px;line-height:1.15;text-align:center;color:#4a4a4a;margin-top:2px;">',
    teams, "</span></div>",
    collapse = ""
  )
  paste0('<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 6px;">', tiles, "</div>")
}

top <- dplyr::filter(counts, rank <= top_n)
rest <- dplyr::filter(counts, rank > top_n)
rest_note <- paste0(rest$state_name, " (", rest$n_schools, ")", collapse = ", ")
zero_note <- paste(sort(setdiff(state.name, counts$state_name)), collapse = ", ")
top_share <- sum(top$n_schools) / nrow(schools)

states_gt <- top |>
  dplyr::mutate(outline = state, logos = purrr::map_chr(schools, logo_strip_html)) |>
  dplyr::select(outline, state_name, n_schools, logos) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_broadsheet(accent = accent_color) |>
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = outline),
    fn = \(x) purrr::map_chr(x, \(state_abb) {
      plot_state_outline(state_abb) |>
        gt::ggplot_image(height = gt::px(90), aspect_ratio = 1)
    })
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = logos) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", size = gt::px(16)),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = state_name)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    outline = "",
    state_name = "State",
    n_schools = gt::html("FBS<br>teams"),
    logos = "Teams"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(outline, n_schools)) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(state_name, logos)) |>
  gt::cols_width(
    outline ~ gt::px(110),
    state_name ~ gt::px(150),
    n_schools ~ gt::px(80),
    logos ~ gt::px(365)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = accent_color, weight = "bold", size = gt::px(22)),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = n_schools)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(v_align = "middle"),
    locations = gt::cells_body()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::html("<b>States with the Most FBS Teams</b>"),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "These five states are home to ", sum(top$n_schools), " of the ",
      nrow(schools), " FBS teams in 2026 (",
      formatC(100 * top_share, format = "f", digits = 0), "%). ",
      nrow(counts), " states have at least one."
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(paste0(
    "<hr>Each dot is a team's home stadium.<br>",
    "The rest: ", rest_note, ".<br>",
    "<hr>No FBS team: ", zero_note, ".<br>",
    "<hr>Table by Chris at Bless your Chart | Data from collegefootballdata.com | cfbtxt.com"
  ))) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = gt::px(13),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(6),
    heading.align = "left",
    table.width = gt::px(740)
  )

states_options <- states_gt[["_options"]]
gtUtils::gt_save_crop(
  states_gt,
  file = "fbs_schools_by_state_2026.png",
  bg = states_options$value[[which(states_options$parameter == "table_background_color")]],
  zoom = 2,
  whitespace = 40
)

states_gt
```
